title: Enderflame
summary: Enderflame is a powerful spell that serves as a magical flamethrower. This spell manifests itself as an orange fire that extends from the caster's hand.

sections.heading: History
sections.text:
Enderflame was used by the Professor to knock Sophie Casterwill through a wall even when she had used Honorguard to try to block it. [The Mission]

This spell was later used by Kiel in Mexico to defeat Dante Vale's Metagolem. [The Titan in the Temple of Sun]

At the battle of the Fortress of Iron Will, Kiel attempted to hit Sophie with this spell but she was defended by Powerbonded Sorcerel, sending her back to her Amulet. [The Spiral War]

full_text:
Enderflame is a powerful spell that serves as a magical flamethrower. This spell manifests itself as an orange fire that extends from the caster's hand.

History

Enderflame was used by the Professor to knock Sophie Casterwill through a wall even when she had used Honorguard to try to block it. [The Mission]

This spell was later used by Kiel in Mexico to defeat Dante Vale's Metagolem. [The Titan in the Temple of Sun]

At the battle of the Fortress of Iron Will, Kiel attempted to hit Sophie with this spell but she was defended by Powerbonded Sorcerel, sending her back to her Amulet. [The Spiral War]
